passage: Fenwick Community Pool, lane swimming, winter schedule. Lane reservations cannot be made on our website this winter while the online system is replaced. Call the front desk at 555-0142 between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m. to hold a lane for that same day. The 6 a.m. lane hour takes no reservation at all. Just show up and wait in line. A reserved lane is held for ten minutes past the start time and is then given to whoever is waiting. Towels are not provided.
prompt: [Daily Life — notice] How can a swimmer hold a lane this winter?
choices: By calling the front desk on the morning of the swim
By reserving a time slot on the pool’s website
By signing the sheet at the front desk when arriving
By emailing the pool on the evening before
correct_answer: By calling the front desk on the morning of the swim
explanation: The notice says the website cannot be used this winter and that a swimmer should call the front desk at 555-0142 between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m. to hold a lane for that same day.

distractor_rationales.choice: By reserving a time slot on the pool’s website
distractor_rationales.reason: The obvious modern default, and the one thing the notice says is unavailable this winter.

distractor_rationales.choice: By signing the sheet at the front desk when arriving
distractor_rationales.reason: Plausible for a small pool; the notice describes a phone call ahead, not a sign-in sheet.

distractor_rationales.choice: By emailing the pool on the evening before
distractor_rationales.reason: A different channel and a different timing from the one stated.

distractor_rationales.choice: It is higher, because of the cost of the floodlights.

distractor_rationales.choice: It is lower, but only for groups that book regularly.

distractor_rationales.choice: It varies with how long the floodlights are on.
distractor_rationales.reason: A metered-lighting arrangement some fields use, but not this one.

passage: Marrowfield Veterinary Clinic, evenings and weekends. Between 7 p.m. and 8 a.m. our phone is not forwarded. passage: From: Ingrid Halvorsen, Willowbeck Cattery. Thank you for booking Mabel and Otis for the fall break week. Two things before you come. Cats from one household share a single pen here. They will be given pens next to each other.

distractor_rationales.choice: They will be given pens next to each other.

distractor_rationales.choice: They will share a pen only if both are well on arrival.
distractor_rationales.reason: Turns the household rule into a conditional it does not carry.
